Titles.jpn: ガンパレード・マーチ 〜新たなる行軍歌〜

Summaries.eng: In 1945, World War II abruptly ended when an alien race appeared on Earth and began to slaughter the human population. The year is 1999 - 54 years later, mankind is still fighting to survive against the alien forces. Earth forces now use advanced mecha called Humanoid Walking Tanks (HWTs) to combat the invaders, but throughout the ordeal, far too many pilots have been killed in action. As a result, high school students are now recruited to become HWT pilots. Gunparade March follows the lives of the 5121st Platoon, who have just added a mysterious girl named Mai Shibamura to their ranks.
Summaries.jpn: 50年前に突如現れた正体不明にして人類史上最悪の敵「幻獣」との戦いは熾烈を極め、疲弊した人類はまだ年端もゆかぬ少年少女をも戦場へと送り出さざるを得ない状況にあった。そして時は1999年。主人公・速水厚志は「5121」部隊の一員として、人型戦車「ＨＷＴ」を駆り最前線に立つ。果たして彼らを待つ未来とは？

Titles.jpn: プレイバック - The Visitor -

Summaries.eng: A "Brain" is discovered in a region of Japan and an disposal mission is ordered. It ended in a huge massacre. A new elite unit is then called to deal with this threat. It's the unit "5121", consisting of young men and women. A new mysterious rookie also happens to lend a helping hand.
Summaries.jpn: 何処より現れし人類の天敵、其れはいつしか”幻獣”と呼ばれていた。5121部隊はPBEによるブレイン殲滅作戦のため出撃する。主人公速水の窮地を救ったHWTのパイロットの正体は？

Titles.eng: Do Whatever You Like - Going My Way
Titles.jpn: 勝手にしやがれ - Going My Way -

Summaries.eng: The new recruit is fueling discussions and debates within the unit "5121". Cold and haughty, the young May Shibimaru does not seem to reach unanimity. However, she will be the victim of the Casanova of the barracks, Takayuki Setoguchi. He will however be trapped by his female colleagues, because of a micro hidden under a desk.
Summaries.jpn: 5121部隊に新たに配属となったHWTパイロット“芝村舞”。素性はさておき、美少女ということで瀬戸口はさっそくナンパのターゲットにするが…。

Titles.jpn: サマータイムブルース - Fire Works -

Summaries.eng: It's finally summer vacation. Unfortunately for our young warriors, they do not have the right to take time off. Yet they will celebrate a sad anniversary of the death of Akane, a former fighter who died in combat. Hayami remembers this sad event and is going to meet the beautiful May, which also assists at the ceremony.
Summaries.jpn: 夏、花火大会、そして死んだ戦友の初盆。5121部隊の一時の休息。茜大介が戦場で散ったあの日をフラッシュバックする。

Summaries.eng: A new mecha, controlled by two pilotes is arriving at the barracks. Now, discussions are underway to determine who will control this new power. According to statistics, the pilots should be Takayuki and May.
Summaries.jpn: 5121部隊に新戦力の複座型HWTが導入される。複座ということで誰と誰がペアを組むのか話題になるのだが…。

Summaries.eng: On the occasion of the 17th cultural festival of the academy of Shoukei, the "5121" unit is preparing a specatcle puppet show of "Hansel and Gretel". The choice of roles is causing some tensions within the team.
Summaries.jpn: 5121部隊に降りかかった痛恨事。それは…。尚敬高校の文化祭当日。人形劇を披露しようとする5121部隊に出撃命令。急ぎ出撃する速水たちだが、中型幻獣のミノタウロスの群の前に苦戦を強いられる。

Titles.eng: After You've Been Gone - I Guess Everything Reminds You of Something
Titles.jpn: 君去りし後 - I Guess Everything Reminds You Of Something -

Summaries.eng: The atmosphere worsened since the death of a team member during a previous mission. Hayami and Mai seem to get better results in terms of the timing of their mecha, but their relationship becomes dull.
Summaries.jpn: 戦闘の最中、友軍救出に向かう速水と舞。しかしブレイン幻獣撃破の全波を浴び動けなくなってしまった。戦場へ取り残された2人は…。

Titles.eng: The Endless Night - In the Forests of Nights
Titles.jpn: 長い夜 - In The Forests Of Nights -

Summaries.eng: The mecha of Hayami and Mai does not respond and can not be found on the radar. They find themselves completely isolated from the rest of the unit and in enemy territory.
Summaries.jpn: 動かないHWT3号機と負傷した舞。速水は舞を背負ってまだ幻獣のうろつく戦場を脱出する事を決意する。

Titles.eng: When April Comes - With Your Musket, Fife, and Drum
Titles.jpn: 四月になれば彼女は - With Your Musket,Fife,And Drum -

Summaries.eng: The months pass quickly and we are already in April. The relationship between Hayami and Mai is still unclear and their journey is getting close to Christmas.
Summaries.jpn: 春の新学期を迎えた尚敬高校。そんな中、速水に届くラブレターが届き。クラスは波乱に沸く。それは舞の関係にも影響を…？

Titles.eng: For You My Heart Trembles - A Day in the Life
Titles.jpn: 君にこそ心ときめく - A Day In The Life -

Summaries.eng: Hayami finally seems to be motivated to speak a little more and he starts to seek advice from his friends about his relationship with May. Trying to confess to May, Hayami hears a discussion between the girls about their relationship. The dishonesty of May ruines his confidence that he has won and leaves him disappointed.
Summaries.jpn: ようやく打ち解け始めたと思いきや、今度はお互いを意識しすぎるあまり、訓練に身が入らない速水と舞。善行と原はそれぞれの方法で2人の関係に介入する。

Titles.eng: Hello Sadness - Once Upon a Dime
Titles.jpn: 悲しみよこんにちは - Once Upon A Dime

Summaries.eng: It's a happy day for Tanabe! She stumbles across a wallet full of money and finds herself elected as the princess for the next piece of the Academy.
Summaries.jpn: 不幸続きの田辺の身の回りで『幸運』な出来事が立て続けに起こる。折りしも今回の出撃時は田辺がPBE起動補佐を担当するとあって、加藤は心配する。

Titles.eng: Unspoken Words - A Good Reward for Their Labour
Titles.jpn: 言い出しかねて - A Good Reward For Their Labour -

Summaries.eng: Following a TV report, Hayami and Mai are found to speak of their mutual testimonials. Their relationship is more frustrating for those around them as they are close, but distant at the same time. May is still struggling to forget her previous love and discharges its emerging feelings.
Summaries.jpn: クリスマスパーティの準備にかこつけて、速水と舞の恋路を応援すべくおぜんだてする5121舞台のメンバーたち。しかし速水は舞の昔話を聞いて、つい失言を…。

Titles.eng: Every Time I Say Good-Bye - Gun Parade March
Titles.jpn: さよならを言う度に - Gun Parade March

Summaries.eng: It's Christmas again and Mai finally decides to reveal her feelings for Hayami.
Summaries.jpn: ガンパレの世界では20世紀が終わろうとしていた。速水は誰と21世紀を迎えるのか?速水と舞の恋の行方は…？
